$comment: Read from Google's YouTube v3 discovery document: playlistItems.insert -> POST youtube/v3/playlistItems, request PlaylistItem, response PlaylistItem. servicePath is empty, so the method path already is the full /youtube/v3/playlistItems path.
title: YouTube playlist item
description: Add a video to a YouTube playlist.
summary: add a video to a playlist
$idempotencyComment: playlistItems.insert exposes no idempotency key. A retried durable run can add the video a SECOND time, so the action is honestly unsafe-to-replay.

query.$comment: part is a REQUIRED query parameter that names both the request properties being written and the response properties included. This action always writes snippet, so `snippet` is a protocol literal the caller never chooses -- exposing a one-option config field would lie about the API.

constants.$comment: ResourceId is generic across videos, playlists and channels. This action adds a VIDEO, so kind is fixed in the nested request body rather than exposed as a choice that could contradict videoId.

config.label: Playlist ID
config.description: The YouTube id of the playlist to add the video to.

config.label: Video ID
config.description: The YouTube id of the video to add.

outputShape.description: YouTube's unique id for the new playlist item.
The video added to the playlist.

$outputComment: playlistItems.insert returns PlaylistItem directly at the response top level; the connector runtime exposes that body under data, without a playlistItem wrapper.

contract.$comment: The query parameter and PlaylistItem fields this action sends and reads, used by discovery drift projection.
